review_note: The approved design defines identity, native state, and additive controls. The leader reviewed hardening through the CLI worker.

deltas.baseline_observation: The baseline uses pgcopydb identity and legacy state.
deltas.target_expectation: Use rpgmigrate identity and native state. Reject legacy state without adoption, conversion, cleanup, or mutation.

deltas.baseline_observation: The baseline has no durability, loss-cap, or apply-jobs options.
deltas.target_expectation: Add durable, replay-safe, relaxed, explicit finite relaxed loss caps, and apply-jobs. Default durability is durable. Default apply-jobs is 1.

deltas.baseline_observation: Dump -F and -N consume no value but their handlers dereference optarg.
deltas.target_expectation: Require a value for dump -F and -N, matching their long forms. Return BadArgs for a missing value.

deltas.baseline_observation: Integer parsing checks int32 bounds. Byte multiplication does not check overflow.
deltas.target_expectation: Reject numeric overflow without wrapping, truncation, or unsafe memory access. Preserve valid unusual integer spellings.

deltas.baseline_observation: Unknown units return true after an error. Suffix scanning discards trailing nonletters.
deltas.target_expectation: Reject unknown units and malformed trailing bytes. Preserve valid integer quantities and binary multipliers.

deltas.baseline_observation: Typed boolean environment bindings do not parse their values.
deltas.target_expectation: Parse boolean environment values. Reject invalid values. Preserve valid CLI-over-environment precedence.

deltas.baseline_observation: An unknown CLI plugin becomes STREAM_PLUGIN_UNKNOWN and can fall back to pgoutput.
deltas.target_expectation: Reject an unknown explicit plugin. Preserve the pgoutput default when no plugin is supplied.

deltas.baseline_observation: The version and dump parsers can exit successfully after invalid options.
deltas.target_expectation: Return BadArgs for invalid options instead of a successful version or help result.

deltas.baseline_observation: The common and stream parsers only log the restart/resume conflict.
deltas.target_expectation: Reject simultaneous restart and resume before runtime work.

deltas.baseline_observation: Several handlers ignore trailing operands. Restore parse-list uses the work directory when its operand count differs from one.
deltas.target_expectation: Reject ignored trailing operational operands with BadConfig before connections or state changes. Preserve operands that the command actually uses.

implementation_policy: Preserve recognition of supported syntax. Fail unsupported runtime behavior before side effects. Do not return success for an unfinished handler.
